assets.name: Shue House Exterior Winter
assets.description: The front of a small wooden farmhouse in West Virginia in January 1896, seen in ordinary cartoon perspective from the front path at a slight angle so both the front wall and one side wall are visible. Each wall is ONE single flat shape of pale grey-blue, the side wall in a slightly DIFFERENT flat tint of the same colour, under a plain dark grey pitched roof drawn as two simple angled planes. The house has EXACTLY ONE plain front door with two plain steps below it and EXACTLY TWO plain square windows in total and no more, each window drawn as one flat pale blue shape crossed by exactly two thin pale white diagonal streak shapes so it plainly reads as glass. To one side stands EXACTLY ONE plain bare winter tree, drawn as one simple trunk with FIVE plain branch lines and no more — no leaves and no twigs. The ground is one plain flat shape of pale snow white, and the near ground across the bottom third of the frame is left completely clear and empty. The sky is ONE flat pale grey band. Draw NO wood grain, NO clapboard lines, NO plank lines, NO brick courses and NO roof shingles anywhere. Cold winter palette of pale grey-blue, white and dark grey in a few flat tints. Plain flat overcast daylight, daytime.
assets.notes: LỖI THỜI — thay bằng bản có hậu tố ' Flat'. Người dùng xem ảnh và loại phong cách phối cảnh: bản gốc (2 điểm tụ) ra mọi vật xoay chéo, bản sửa 1 điểm tụ vẫn còn lệch.
